hub.title: Client app
hub.body: Choose which parts of the app your clients see.

title: Client app

subtitle.tenant: Turn modules on or off for every client. A client override can still win.
subtitle.client: Choose which parts of the app {name} sees. This only affects this client.

readOnly.title: View only
readOnly.tenant: Only the owner can change the defaults for all clients.
readOnly.client: Changing one client's app needs permission to edit clients and to edit billing.

intro.tenant: These defaults apply to every client unless a client override wins.
intro.client: Inherit follows your defaults. Show or Hide changes this module for this client only.

scope: Hiding a module hides it from the client's tabs, Today and Me and blocks its writes. It does not change package access, and hiding payments never voids a payment.

workouts.name: Workouts
workouts.help: The program, the workout screen and workout history.

nutrition.name: Nutrition
nutrition.help: The meal plan, meal logging and nutrition history.

checkins.name: Check-ins
checkins.help: Check-in forms, their reminders and the intake form.

payments.name: Payments
payments.help: The subscription, payments and renewal notices.

choice.groupLabel: {module}: choose how it appears for this client

state.nowIs: Now for this client: {state, select, on {shown} other {hidden}}
state.otherOverride: Another saved override also sets this module for this client. It is not changed here.

summary.allOff: Every module is off. The client app will have nothing on Today.

status.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.
status.resetDone: Reset. This client follows the defaults again.
status.unknown: We could not confirm whether this was saved. Check the saved state, or retry the same request.

errors.validation: The server did not accept these choices. Nothing was saved.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again, then save. Nothing was saved.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this. Nothing was saved.
errors.not_found: This client was not found. Nothing was saved.
errors.unprocessable: These choices cannot be saved right now. Nothing was saved.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this at the same time. Check the saved state and try again.
errors.in_progress: The same request is still running. Wait a moment and check the saved state.
errors.server: The server had a problem. We could not confirm whether this was saved.
errors.network: The connection failed. We could not confirm whether this was saved.
errors.load: Could not load the client app settings. Try again.
